prompt:
THE BACKGROUND MUST BE FLAT SOLID MAGENTA #FF00FF, filling every pixel behind the figure, edge to edge. THE BACKGROUND IS NOT BLACK. IT IS NOT NAVY, NOT DARK BLUE, NOT PURPLE, NOT A NIGHT SKY, NOT WHITE, NOT ORANGE, NOT A GRADIENT, NOT FOG, NOT A FIELD. If you are about to render a dark or night background because the subject is glowing, RENDER PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF INSTEAD. No shadow on the backdrop, no ground plane, no frame, no border, no text, no watermark.

A FULL-LENGTH STANDING FIGURE, HEAD TO FEET, both feet resting at the very bottom edge of the frame, the whole body visible from the top of the head to the soles of both boots. NOT a bust, NOT a portrait, NOT cropped at the waist or the knees. A single character, standing, facing the viewer, drawn large.

A FRIENDLY JACK-O'-LANTERN FIGURE. His head is a round carved orange pumpkin with a WARM, KIND, SMILING carved face — two friendly triangular eyes and a wide happy grin, glowing warm golden-orange from inside as if a candle burns within, with soft light spilling out of the carved openings. A short curled green stem on top. THE FACE IS CHEERFUL AND WELCOMING, NOT scary, NOT menacing, NOT snarling, NOT evil, no fangs, no sharp teeth, no red eyes.

He wears a DEEP INDIGO-BLUE HOODED CLOAK with the hood pushed back off the pumpkin head, over a warm charcoal tunic to the knee, a brown leather belt, and sturdy brown boots. Autumn colours, warm and homely.

IN HIS RIGHT HAND HE HOLDS UP A SMALL LIT LANTERN — a simple brass-and-glass candle lantern on a ring handle, raised to about shoulder height, glowing warm gold. His left hand is open and relaxed at his side. NO weapon, nothing scary, no scythe, no chains, nothing skeletal.

Warm hand-illustrated storybook style with clean flat shapes and soft painted shading, matching the reference figures exactly in proportion, line weight and palette warmth. The glow is warm and gentle, painted ON the figure only — it must NOT spill onto the background, which stays FLAT MAGENTA #FF00FF. Head to feet, full length, both feet at the bottom edge.
